_comment: Body app, Train tab, Gyms. Every gym and fitness facility in Burlington, South Burlington, Winooski, Essex, Williston and Colchester that we could confirm open. Prices and hours are copied as published on each facility's own site (or the booking page its site links to) on the date in 'verified'. 'verified' is null when the core facts (address, hours, at least one price) could not all be confirmed on the facility's own site; 'unverified' names each missing or shaky field and why. In 'has', null means the site does not say. Prices change; re-check before quoting one in an edition.
